title: Policy
description: Formal spec §6.3. The configurable consensus thresholds governing a ward's guardians.
$comment: REQ-7-29/REQ-7-34: `extensions` is the forward-compatibility member -- a verifier ignores an extension whose name is NOT in the operation's `critical` (REQ-7-34), whether or not it implements it. One that IS in `critical` and isn't implemented makes the verification result unsupported instead (REQ-8-1), not ignored.

recovery.description: REQ-6-11: governs guardian approval of update, acceptWard and releaseWard. Allowed: "any", "majority", "all", integer k (REQ-6-13: 1-32). Default "majority".

membership.description: REQ-6-11: governs guardian approval of addGuardian and setPolicy. Allowed: "majority", "all", integer k (REQ-6-13: 1-32) -- never "any". Default "majority".

removal.description: REQ-6-11: governs guardian approval of removeGuardian. Allowed: "any", "majority", "all", integer k (REQ-6-13: 1-32). Default "majority".

deactivation.description: REQ-6-11/REQ-6-12: governs approval of deactivate. Default {"by": "both", "threshold": "majority"}.

threshold.description: REQ-6-12/REQ-6-13: "majority", "all", or an integer k (1-32) -- never "any".

orphan.description: REQ-6-11/REQ-6-14: the change applied by REQ-6-10 when a removeGuardian leaves `guardians` empty. MUST be "successor" if this identity's `successor` is an entry, and MUST NOT be "successor" if `successor` is null. Default "deactivate".

maxWards.description: REQ-6-11/REQ-6-15: the largest allowed size of `wards`. Absent means no limit.

extensions.description: REQ-7-29: each member name is an extension name (an absolute URI); each value is defined by that extension. Ignored by a verifier when the name isn't in `critical` (REQ-7-34); makes the result unsupported, not ignored, when it is and the verifier doesn't implement it (REQ-8-1).
